result:
I've made changes for all nine reports. The project type-checks with no errors, but I did not run the test suite and have not exercised any of the changes.

- **Mentions (reports 1, 2):** The service now loads every active, non-archived member of the workspace, with no cap of 100 and no role filter. A handle shared by several members mentions all of them. Only what the text mentions is recorded, minus the author. Previously the client-supplied mention ids were merged in; I dropped that.
- **Alerts (reports 3, 8):** On a new comment, the issue author, the assignee and the author of the parent comment (for a reply) get a "comment added" alert. Anyone who is also mentioned gets only the mention alert. The existing `notify` already skips the comment's author.
- **Thread and delete (reports 4, 5):** Replies are now grouped under their top-level ancestor at any depth, in posting order. A deleted comment stays in the thread as a placeholder with an empty body, and its `archivedAt` is still set so the UI can mark it. The comment count already excluded deleted comments.
- **Edits (reports 6, 7):** The fifteen-minute window now counts from `createdAt` instead of `updatedAt`. An edit re-reads the mentions and stores them. It alerts only the newly mentioned people and re-indexes the new text for search. I call `notify` and `indexComment` directly from the comment service rather than adding a new `comment.updated` event, because a new event would also have to be added to the activity label and schema lists.
- **Rate limit (report 9):** `consumeRateLimit` takes an optional subject, so the comment bucket is now charged per member. I removed the duplicate workspace-wide charge from `create-comment.ts`, so the service is now the only place that charges. The side effect is that the action no longer throws `RateLimitedError`; callers get the service's generic error instead.

The changes are in `src/lib/mentions.ts`, `src/lib/rate-limit.ts`, `src/server/services/comment-service.ts`, `src/server/services/notification-service.ts`, `src/server/repositories/comment-repository.ts`, `src/server/repositories/member-repository.ts` and `src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts`.
